subject: Quick thought on The Dentists at Ralston Square website
body: Hi Team at The Dentists at Ralston Square, Having been voted Omaha Magazine's 'Best Family Dentist' for 18 consecutive years, your practice clearly offers exceptional care across your four neighborhood offices. While reviewing your site, I noticed that the primary booking call-to-action buttons in the header tend to blend into the navigation rather than standing out for mobile patients, and some blog categories could benefit from structured topical hubs rather than remaining uncategorized. Because of your stellar reputation under Dr. Jay Samuelson, I put together a modern, high-performance prototype to give your online presence the same polished feel as your in-office experience. You can view the live preview here: https://nayom-biz-0x87938b806e8fc16d-0xe58ebcba13c1d3e.vercel.app. Feel free to explore the prototype. If you like the cleaner layout or want me to adjust anything, I'd be glad to send over the project files or chat for 5 minutes. No worries at all if you are completely happy with your current setup!
key_improvements: Added high-contrast styling to the primary appointment booking buttons to improve conversion rates
Cleaned up uncategorized blog tags into structured topical hubs for better navigation and SEO
